name: Doki Doki Salvation
source:
It’s a mod in which you get to save Sayori and play through the events after you save her. What makes this stand out however it’s that Monika loses her abilities to manipulate the game, and she isn’t too happy about that...

[From [url=https://www.dokidokimodclub.com/mod/55/]Official site[/url]]
